facts.text: The hotel sits on 26 acres of green land on Bolgatty Island, overlooking the backwaters of Vembanad Lake.
facts.excerpt: Perched on 26 acres of plush green land on serene Bolgatty Island, Grand Hyatt Kochi Bolgatty is an urban waterfront resort overlooking the backwaters of Vembanad Lake.

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Kochi Bolgatty describes itself as an urban waterfront resort.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Kochi Bolgatty is an urban waterfront resort overlooking the backwaters of Vembanad Lake

facts.text: Rooms and suites offer lake and city views, and the accommodations include villas with plunge pools and private access.
facts.excerpt: Offering lake and city views, Grand Hyatt Kochi Bolgatty features 264 luxurious rooms, including 38 suites and four villas with plunge pools and private access.

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Villa has a living room, a private kitchen, a private plunge pool and a private balcony overlooking Vembanad Lake.
facts.excerpt: this 214-square-metre villa has a spacious living room, a private kitchen and two bedrooms to comfortably house a family of four and an attendant

facts.text: The Grand Terrace Suite has a large living area, a walk-in wardrobe and a private terrace with views of Vembanad Lake.
facts.excerpt: a plush king bed, a large living area, a walk-in wardrobe and a private terrace with splendid views of Vembanad Lake

facts.text: Santata Spa combines Western relaxation techniques with Ayurvedic therapies.
facts.excerpt: Our Santata Spa takes inspiration from both Western relaxation techniques and centuries’ old, time-tested Ayurvedic therapies.

facts.text: Santata Spa has seven treatment rooms, an indoor pool, hydrotherapy facilities and relaxation lounges.
facts.excerpt: The 11,000+ sq. ft. spa is home to seven treatment rooms, an indoor pool, hydrotherapy facilities and serene relaxation lounges.

facts.text: The grounds include a yoga lawn, a spice garden and a private jetty for backwater escapes.
facts.excerpt: with a yoga lawn, exploration gardens, a spice garden, outdoor pool, children’s pool, beauty salon and even a private jetty for backwater escapes

facts.text: The outdoor pool is surrounded by gardens overlooking the backwaters and includes a children's pool; there is also an indoor pool overlooking the gardens.
facts.excerpt: The outdoor pool also includes a children’s pool. Additionally, enjoy a beautiful indoor pool on the P level that overlooks our lush gardens.

facts.text: The hotel offers luxury houseboats on Vembanad Lake for experiencing Kochi from the water.
facts.excerpt: Set against the tranquil expanse of Vembanad Lake, the luxury houseboats at Grand Hyatt Kochi Bolgatty offer an immersive backwater experience

facts.text: Chinese fishing nets, a symbol of Kochi's maritime heritage, stand on the grounds against the hotel's waterfront facade.
facts.excerpt: the iconic Chinese fishing nets stand gracefully against the backdrop of the hotel’s striking waterfront facade. This timeless symbol of Kochi’s maritime heritage

facts.text: The hotel can arrange experiences such as backwater tours, food and spice trail tours and boat races.
facts.excerpt: including backwater tours, elephant rides, wildlife visits, bird sightings, food and spice trail tours, boat races and more

facts.text: Malabar Cafe serves an all-day menu of traditional Kerala recipes.
facts.excerpt: Relax at our modern café that features an all-day menu with Kerala region’s age-old treasured recipes crafted by our team of Chefs.

facts.text: Colony Bar has waterfront views and serves crafted cocktails and premium spirits.
facts.excerpt: With breathtaking waterfront views, our bar offers a refined atmosphere, harmonizing modern design with local charm. Savor meticulously crafted cocktails and a premium spirits selection

facts.text: Thai Soul is a casual poolside restaurant with a live kitchen, inspired by the streets of Bangkok.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the vibrant streets of Bangkok, Thai Soul is a casual poolside dining space. The aroma of fresh Thai herbs and flavours comes alive in the live kitchen

facts.text: Grand Club access includes breakfast, appetizers, beverages and evening refreshments, and many club rooms and suites have Vembanad Lake views.
facts.excerpt: Grand Club access includes complimentary breakfast, appetizers, beverages, evening refreshments, boardroom access and more.

facts.text: The hotel has more than 30 indoor and outdoor event venues, including lakeside wedding settings.
facts.excerpt: Whether it’s a wedding by the lake, a large conference or a corporate meeting, we have the ideal space for you. With more than 30 indoor and outdoor venues for your event needs

facts.text: Cochin International Airport is 32 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Cochin International Airport (COK)32 kilometers32 kilometers

facts.text: The hotel offers complimentary valet parking.
facts.excerpt: We offer complimentary valet parking for guests of Grand Hyatt Kochi Bolgatty.

facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours with cardio and strength equipment and personal trainers.
facts.excerpt: Open 24 hours a day, our centre offers the latest cardio and strength-training equipment. Plus, expert personal trainers are happy to assist.
